technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals conflict with bearish price structure below key moving averages and weak trend confirmation; high-risk bounce setup rather than high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CMG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 22 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts junior members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but recent congressional sales and lack of news confirmation create mixed signals with bearish market sentiment (61% bearish) dominating.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational consumer discretionary, and earnings event in 22 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with stochRSI bullish cross and contrarian fear sentiment (17/100) create textbook bounce setup at support (29.75), offering asymmetric risk/reward for tactical entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price structure is decisively bearish—below EMA 9/21/50/200, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud, pSAR bearish, ADX weak—combined with macro crisis (VIX 322.4, inverted yield curve, strong dollar), high earnings risk in 22 days, and zero institutional/insider conviction make this a low-probability bounce trap in a recession-signal environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI (9) with stochRSI bullish cross and fear-zone sentiment (17/100) create tactical bounce potential at support (29.75). However, decisive bearish price structure below all key moving averages, zero institutional conviction, and macro crisis environment (VIX 322.4, inverted yield curve) make this a low-probability setup with asymmetric downside risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 22 days combined with macro recession signals (inverted yield curve, strong dollar headwind) could trigger gap-down move below support, invalidating bounce thesis entirely.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 4 positions in Consumer Discretionary sector; adding CMG increases concentration risk in volatile, macro-sensitive segment during crisis conditions.
